title: State of Singapore's Relations with China in View of Seizure of Terrex Vehicles
what_it_is: State of Singapore's Relations with China in View of Seizure of Terrex Vehicles

sections.label: Singapore-China investment and trade
sections.summary: Since 2013, Singapore has been China's largest foreign investor and China has been Singapore's largest trading partner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Since 2013, Singapore has been China's largest foreign investor and China has been Singapore's largest trading partner.

sections.label: One China policy basis
sections.summary: Relations with China and interactions with Hong Kong and Taiwan are based strictly on Singapore's One China policy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Our relations with China, and our interactions with Hong Kong and Taiwan are based strictly on our "One China" policy.

sections.label: China engagement and projects
sections.summary: The speaker made four working trips to China last year and remains committed to three government-to-government projects and new areas of engagement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Just last year alone, I made four working trips to China.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We remain committed to the three government-to-government projects, namely, the Suzhou Industrial Park, the Tianjin Eco-city and the Chongqing Connectivity Initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We continue our engagement with our Chinese partners at multiple levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We are also engaging China in new areas, such as the Belt and Road initiative, and we are working together to conclude negotiations on the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership.

sections.label: No formal market access restrictions
sections.summary: As far as the speaker knows, there have been no formal restrictions on market access of Singaporean parties.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: As far as I know, so far at this point in time, there has not been any formal restrictions on market access of Singaporean parties, whether commercial, clan associations or the rest.

sections.label: No dialogue opened with China
sections.summary: The short answer is that Singapore has not opened dialogue with China.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The final supplementary question on whether we have opened dialogue with China, the short answer is no, we have not.

sections.label: Hong Kong investigations and legal process
sections.summary: Singapore was assured by Hong Kong that investigations are ongoing and the matter will be handled in accordance with their law.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The other thing that we expect is that the law will take its course.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: So, in this specific case, we have been informed, in fact, we have been assured by Hong Kong that investigations are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: But the important point that it will be handled in accordance with their law is a very important assurance, and one that we welcome because it is best that this matter be handled through the proper legal process.

sections.label: Singapore as friend of China
sections.summary: Singapore has been a long-term, reliable and consistent friend of China.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The first point I want to make is that Singapore has been a long-term, reliable and consistent friend of China.

sections.label: Maintaining independence, many friends
sections.summary: Singapore wants to maintain its independence and have as many friends as possible, not acting at any single superpower's behest.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We want to maintain our independence and to have as many friends as possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We cannot be at the beck and call, or act at the behest of any single superpower.

sections.label: Trade agreements and GDP
sections.summary: Whether TPP, RCEP or other free trade agreements, trade represents three times Singapore's gross domestic product.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Whether it is the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP), Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) or any other free trade agreement, the point is this: trade represents three times our gross domestic product.

sections.label: Standing together on foreign policy
sections.summary: The Workers' Party and all Members of the House hopefully stand with the Government, because foreign policy begins at home.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Mr Low Thia Khiang, I am glad to say ‒ and I hope Mr Low will agree with me ‒ that this is an issue on which the Workers' Party, in fact, hopefully, all Members of this House, whether from the Opposition, Non-Constituency Members of Parliament or Nominated Members of Parliament, stand with the Government, that this is one of those occasions for us to learn the right lessons, to stand together because, ultimately, foreign policy begins at home.

sections.label: Hong Kong investigations and laws
sections.summary: Hong Kong said it is conducting investigations and will handle the matter according to its laws, a position Singapore welcomes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Hong Kong has told us they are conducting investigations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: They told us that they will handle this in accordance with their laws.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Both the Minister for Defence and I stand before you, and I am sure the message will be conveyed to them that we welcome this position, that Hong Kong will handle this according to its laws.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I should add that China also has publicly stated that this will be handled according to Hong Kong SAR's laws.

sections.label: One China policy basis
sections.summary: Singapore's relations with China and interactions with Hong Kong and Taiwan are based strictly on its One China policy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Our relations with China and our interactions with Hong Kong and Taiwan are based strictly on our One China policy.
